resources.string: Label this moment, for example “turned off Wi-Fi”
Recording is paused, so a mark won’t be kept.

A mark is a labelled moment in the log, and tweaks you apply or undo are marked automatically. For each mark, BooxUltimatum compares the draw while asleep before and after it, leaving out sleeps in which the processor stayed awake. If the difference is no bigger than a normal day-to-day change, it says so.
Not enough data yet. It needs at least 12 hours asleep on each side of the mark.
Within a normal day-to-day change: the draw while asleep was %1$s before and %2$s after.
The draw while asleep fell from %1$s to %2$s.
The draw while asleep rose from %1$s to %2$s.
Day to day, the draw while asleep varies by about %1$s.
